mentions.name: OSINT.moe
mentions.description: An LLM chat helper app for OSINT that builds a graph of the user's knowledge base. It glues together specialized APIs (search, scrapers, tools, etc.) so the user rarely needs to leave the app.
mentions.problem: OSINT work requires switching between many specialized tools; this consolidates them into a single chat interface.
